title: Snapjaw

{{Stub}}'''Snapjaws''' are [[neutral]] level 30-31 [[turtle]]s found in the [[Alterac Mountains]] and [[Hillsbrad Foothills]].

The [[Albino Snapjaw]], [[Hawksbill Snapjaw]], [[Leatherback Snapjaw]], [[Loggerhead Snapjaw]], and [[Olive Snapjaw]], a miniature snapjaw, can be obtained as a small pet.
